notes: Drona Parva, fourteenth day. Jayadratha-vadha. Krishna is the Ep 09 look lock (charioteer, not flute). No gore: gold shaft-light, crowned head as a disc of light into the father’s lap. Drona is field commander on the wall plate only. Vriddhakshatra is an aged Sindhu king, not a saffron sage.

krishna.face: Youthful divine smile, dusty-blue skin, dark eyes, serene, U-tilak — same face as Ep 09 lock
krishna.hair: Dark curly hair, gold crown with one peacock feather
krishna.costume: Yellow pitambar, flower garlands, gold jewelry, charioteer reins — never a flute, never a bow

arjuna.face: Noble warrior prince, dark mustache, same face as Ep 09–11
arjuna.costume: Cream-white dhoti, gold belt, quiver on back, Gandiva — never flower garland

jayadratha.face: Adult Sindhu king, proud mustache, hard gaze — same as Ep 11 gate
jayadratha.hair: Dark hair under a jeweled royal crown
jayadratha.costume: Jewel-tone crimson and gold Sindhu armor, shield — field king, not a forest abductor

drona.face: Aged acharya-warrior, noble lined face, long white beard and mustache (guru on the field, not a garden sage)
drona.hair: White hair in a saffron-bound topknot, rudraksha — no Kuru silver diadem of Bhishma
drona.costume: Saffron angavastram over pale gold-white armor, bow of the guru, cream dhoti

vriddhakshatra.face: Aged Sindhu king, lined noble face, white mustache and beard — a seated father-king, not Drona, not a sage
vriddhakshatra.hair: White hair under a jeweled Sindhu crown (not saffron topknot)
vriddhakshatra.costume: Crimson and gold royal robes, seated on a low throne — never saffron acharya robes, never a bow of the guru

armies.costume: Muted banners, equal human scale, no gore
